notes: Read SKILL.md, references/non-hero-scenarios.md and references/capabilities.md in full. Python guide to azure-storage-file-datalake (ADLS Gen2): DefaultAzureCredential clients, file-system/directory/file create, rename, upload (including append/flush), download, delete, path listing, properties/metadata, POSIX ACLs and the async client.

Medium only because SKILL.md:20 has `pip install azure-storage-file-datalake azure-identity` (official Microsoft packages, unpinned). All storage operations are sample code for the user's application against their own account; credentials come from DefaultAzureCredential with placeholder account URLs, and the agent is not told to read or transmit secrets.

Samples include destructive or permission-changing service calls users should guard: delete_file_system (SKILL.md:78), delete_directory/delete_file, upload with overwrite=True, and recursive ACL updates (SKILL.md:188-197). The download-to-file sample writes downloaded.txt locally in user code. references/non-hero-scenarios.md duplicates SKILL.md sections.
